localFacts.fact: Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 56 x 40 x 25 cm. The Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 (61 cm closed, maker) is too long; the K&F (54 cm folded) fits within 56 cm.
Alhambra (Patronato): photos only without flash and without tripod, monopod or other stabilising element – a tall tripod does not help inside the monument.
Sagrada Família normativa: no photos or videos with a tripod inside the grounds unless accredited by the press department.
Manfrotto's maker spec sheet: 170 cm max, 140 cm with the centre column down, 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall Spanish photographers (1.90 m) say short supports force them to stoop a lot.
localPainPoints.fix: Check legs-only height against 'height minus 25-30 cm'; the K&F reaches 162 cm without the column.
